definitions.gloss: shy person; easily embarrassed person; someone who gets flustered easily
definitions.explanation: A person who is easily embarrassed or gets flustered, especially when praised or put in the spotlight. Often used affectionately to describe this trait.

examples.japanese: {照|て}れ{屋|や}なので{褒|ほ}められると{顔|かお}が{赤|あか}くなる。
examples.english: I'm easily embarrassed, so my face turns red when I'm praised.

examples.japanese: うちの{息子|むすこ}は{照|て}れ{屋|や}で、{人前|ひとまえ}で{話|はな}すのが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: My son is shy and not good at speaking in front of others.

notes:
{照|て}れ{屋|や} describes someone who gets embarrassed easily, especially when praised or put in the spotlight. It has a warm, endearing connotation — not a negative trait.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {照|て}れる (to be embarrassed, to feel shy) + {屋|や} (suffix for a person with a characteristic trait).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}だ (to be the shy type)
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}なので〜 (because I'm easily embarrassed, ~)
- {照|て}れ{屋|や}な{性格|せいかく} (a shy personality)

SIMILAR {屋|や}/{坊|ぼう} PERSONALITY WORDS:
- {恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}: shy person (general shyness)
- {寂|さび}しがり{屋|や}: person who gets lonely easily
- {甘|あま}えん{坊|ぼう}: clingy/spoiled person
- {怒|おこ}りん{坊|ぼう}: hot-tempered person

NUANCE:
Unlike {恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や} which implies broader social shyness, {照|て}れ{屋|や} specifically describes someone who gets flustered by praise or attention.
